prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests, such as predicting a +20.0% gain for sign-in reordering and +4.0% for a finish screen that performed significantly worse.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Controls Visual Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a two-column layout displaying interactive overview cards for controlling, hiding, and interacting with your pet. (why: Support received multiple emails about users feeling confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet right after completing onboarding.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Status Wait Info: Show clear step-by-step preparation status messages and estimated remaining render time on the waiting screen while the pet is initialized on the desktop. (why: Support reported pets not appearing on desktop and the app stalling, while the home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Friend Selection Flow: Introduce a multi-step companion selection flow with animated preview stages before finalizing pet adoption details. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off in the funnel (60.9% conversion, median 89s), indicating friction when choosing or customizing pets.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint: Display a sign-in safety hint explaining that signing in backs up existing pets and syncs progress across devices without resetting pets. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Two Column Comparison Layout: Transform the choose path screen layout to a structured two-column comparison highlighting standard pets versus custom creation paths. (why: Path selection mean time is high (514s), suggesting user hesitation and confusion between preset and custom creation options.)
5: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two Column Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout with companion attributes on one side and certificate details on the other. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%), and users reported issues with custom pet generation feedback.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Quick Tray Shortcut Hint: Add an explicit hint on the final onboarding screen showing how to access quick pet options from the system taskbar tray icon. (why: Support tickets highlight user confusion around hiding or summoning the pet after setup.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Notification: Enable system desktop notifications to alert users automatically as soon as pet creation and desktop placement finishes. (why: The waiting step has extremely long mean completion time (2336s), leading to user reports of missing pets or perceived app freezes.)
8: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Companion Path Assistant Flow: Add a checklist-driven path selection assistant that guides users to either instant adoption or custom photo creation based on their goal. (why: Choose path screen conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s due to decision uncertainty.)
